tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The 14 statistics topics on Monte, in order, with their page links.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: One topic in plain English: the idea, why it matters, a worked example, the usual trap, the formulas and the five lessons, with links.

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Statistics terms in plain English with an example each, matched on the term or its meaning.

tools.name: list_solvers
tools.description: The 11 solvers and the inputs each one takes (key, label, default value, and choices where there are some). Use with solve.

tools.name: solve
tools.description: Runs one of Monte's solvers and returns every answer with its working, exactly as the solver page shows it. Inputs you leave out keep the solver's defaults. Numbers may be written as 0.7, 70% or 7/10.

tools.name: test_result
tools.description: For a positive result, the chance you really have the thing, from how common it is, how often the test catches it and how often it false-alarms (Bayes).

tools.name: warranty
tools.description: Expected cost of buying versus skipping a warranty or insurance plan, the break-even chance and the plan's markup.

tools.name: ab_test
tools.description: Two-proportion z test for an A/B test: the two rates, the lift, the p-value, a 95% range for the difference, and visitors needed per version to detect this gap.
